scripts.build: cp index.html www/index.html && cp 'At All Costs - The Grey Room _ Golden Palms.mp3' 'www/At All Costs - The Grey Room _ Golden Palms.mp3' && mkdir -p 'www/sound effects' && cp 'sound effects/jump.mp3' 'www/sound effects/jump.mp3' && cp 'sound effects/star.mp3' 'www/sound effects/star.mp3' && cp 'sound effects/death.mp3' 'www/sound effects/death.mp3'
scripts.sync: npm run build && npx cap sync
scripts.open:ios: npm run sync && npx cap open ios
scripts.open:android: npm run sync && npx cap open android
scripts.build:ios:sim: cd ios/App && xcodebuild -project App.xcodeproj -scheme App -configuration Debug -destination 'platform=iOS Simulator,name=iPhone 17' CODE_SIGNING_ALLOWED=NO build
